reservation.eyebrow: Al Haramain Reservation · B2B division of Nusuk Help
reservation.title: Reservation and ground handling inside the Kingdom
reservation.lead: Hotels, transport, Haramain rail, ziyarat, permit assistance and complete ground handling — arranged from our office in Madinah for travel agencies, groups and individual pilgrims.

hotels.lead: Rooms in Makkah and Madinah across every grade — Markaziyah properties within walking distance of the Haram, and quieter hotels a short transfer away. We work with a range of properties directly and confirm what is genuinely free on your dates rather than quoting from a list.

points.grades: Five-star to economy, in Makkah and Madinah, central and outer areas
points.blocks: Room blocks for groups, held together under a single booking
points.meals: Room-only, breakfast or full board, according to each hotel's own plans
points.distance: Distance to the Haram described as it actually is, not rounded down
points.availability: Rates and rooms confirmed for your dates, subject to availability

transport.lead: Airport transfers, intercity movements and vehicles held for the length of a group's stay. GMC, Hiace and coaches, matched to the size of the party rather than to whatever happens to be free.

points.airport: Arrival and departure transfers at Jeddah and Madinah airports
points.intercity: Makkah, Madinah and Jeddah, in either direction, at the times you set
points.fleet: GMC, Hiace, minibus and coach, chosen for the size of the group
points.ziyaratRuns: Vehicles held for ziyarat days and local movement
points.drivers: Drivers briefed on the itinerary before the group lands

rail.lead: Seats on the Haramain High-Speed Rail between Makkah, Jeddah and Madinah, booked together for the group and coordinated with the transfers waiting at each end.

points.routes: Makkah, Jeddah and Madinah stations, in both directions
points.groupTickets: Group tickets booked as one block where seats allow
points.stationTransfers: Transfers to and from the station, timed to the train
points.timings: Guidance on timings, luggage and what to expect at the station
points.operator: Fares, seats and timetables are set by the rail operator — we book against what is open

ziyarat.lead: Guided visits to the historical and religious sites of Madinah and Makkah, with experienced guides and vehicles sized to the group.

points.madinahSites: Madinah — Quba, Uhud, Masjid al-Qiblatain and the surrounding sites
points.makkahSites: Makkah — Mina, Arafat, Muzdalifah, Jabal al-Nour and Jabal Thawr
points.guides: Guides who know the sites and the etiquette expected at each
points.halfOrFullDay: Half-day or full-day routes, for a family or for a full coach

permits.lead: Permits for Hajj, Umrah and specific sites are issued by the Saudi authorities through their own official channels. What we do is help you through that process: explaining which permits your itinerary needs, what each application asks for, and how to submit it correctly. The decision is always the authorities'.

points.whichPermits: Guidance on which permits your itinerary needs, and which it does not
points.documents: Help preparing the information and documents an application asks for
points.application: Step-by-step support completing the application on the official platform
points.timing: Guidance on when to start, and what the process usually involves
points.outcome: Help understanding the result of an application, and reapplying if you choose to

permits.note: Permits are issued only by the official Saudi authorities, through their own channels. Our role is assistance, guidance and coordination with that process. We cannot obtain a permit on your behalf, we have no access to any official system that is not open to every applicant, and we cannot promise that any application will be approved.

groundHandling.lead: One team on the ground from arrival to departure — meeting the group at the airport, running the hotel check-in, moving them between cities, and staying reachable for as long as they are in the Kingdom.

points.meetAndAssist: Meet and assist on arrival, with the transfer already waiting
points.checkIn: Hotel check-in and check-out handled for the whole group
points.movement: Movement between Makkah, Madinah and Jeddah on your schedule
points.namedCoordinator: One named coordinator responsible for the file
points.reachable: A contact reachable around the clock while the group is here
points.reporting: The agency kept informed, without having to chase us

closing.heading: Tell us the dates and the group
closing.body: Send the city, the dates, the number of guests and the grade you have in mind. We will come back with what is available and what it costs.

b2b.title: A partner on the Saudi side of the journey
b2b.lead: Al Haramain Reservation is the B2B division of Nusuk Help. You sell the pilgrimage; we handle what happens once your group lands — hotels, transport, rail, ziyarat and ground handling, run by our own team from Madinah.

handle.heading: Six services, one partner
handle.intro: Everything below is arranged and operated by us inside the Kingdom. Each one links to the full detail.

brief.title: Send us the brief
brief.body: Dates, city, group size, hotel grade and anything specific your client has asked for. WhatsApp is enough — there is no portal to learn.

options.title: We come back with options
options.body: What is genuinely available on those dates, with alternatives where a property is full, and a price against each. We are not an availability engine; a person checks.

confirm.title: You confirm
confirm.body: We hold the booking, issue the documentation, and coordinate the details with the hotels and suppliers on your behalf.

operate.title: We run it on the ground
operate.body: Arrival, transfers, check-in and movement between cities, with one named contact responsible for the file from first enquiry to check-out.

benefits.heading: Built around how agencies actually work

confidential.heading: A document your client can see
confidential.body: Every booking can be issued two ways: a full invoice for your own accounts, and a confidential copy with all amounts removed. Your client gets a document that confirms the booking, the hotel and the dates — and shows them nothing about what you paid us.
confidential.note: Both are generated from the same booking, so they can never disagree about the dates, the rooms or the guests.

closing.heading: Send us your next group
closing.body: Tell us what you are working on — the city, the dates and the group. If we can cover it, we will come back with options; if we cannot, we will say so.

meta.title: About us
meta.description: Nusuk Help is an independent Hajj and Umrah services company based in Madinah Al Munawarah, with a B2B reservation and ground-handling division, Al Haramain Reservation.

about.title: An independent company, based in Madinah
about.lead: Nusuk Help helps pilgrims prepare for Hajj and Umrah, and handles the Saudi side of the journey for travel agencies abroad. We work from Madinah Al Munawarah — which is the difference between arranging a trip and being there when it happens.

mission.heading: Make the Saudi side of the journey straightforward
mission.bodyOne: Most of what goes wrong on a pilgrimage goes wrong on the ground: a hotel further from the Haram than the brochure suggested, a transfer that does not arrive, a permit application started too late. Those are local problems, and they are solved locally.
mission.bodyTwo: So the company is built around being here. We arrange the rooms, the vehicles, the rail seats and the ziyarat routes ourselves, we guide people through the official permit process, and we stay reachable while a group is in the Kingdom. For an agency, that means one partner instead of five suppliers in a country it cannot visit.

structure.label: Structure
structure.value: One company, two divisions — Nusuk Help for pilgrims, Al Haramain Reservation for agencies

coverage.label: Where we operate
coverage.value: Makkah, Madinah and Jeddah, and elsewhere in the Kingdom on request

desks.label: Desks
desks.value: Saudi Arabia and Bangladesh, for groups travelling from South Asia

independence.heading: Who we are not
independence.body: Our name describes what we help people with — the Nusuk platform — not who we are. We are a private company. We are not an official body, and permits, approvals and platform decisions are matters for the Saudi authorities alone. Where we help with an application, we do it through the same official channels that are open to everyone.

closing.heading: Talk to a person
closing.body: Whether you are planning your own Umrah or moving a group of two hundred, the first step is the same: tell us what you need.

meta.title: Privacy policy
meta.description: How Nusuk Help handles the information you send through this website — reviews, enquiries and messages.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: This policy explains what this website collects, why, and what happens to it. It describes what the site actually does rather than trying to cover every eventuality, and it will be revised as the site grows.

scope.title: What this policy covers
scope.body: This policy covers nusukhelp.com, the public website. It does not cover the private booking system our staff use, or what happens after you become a client — that is governed by the terms issued with your booking.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body: The website has no accounts and no login. We hold only what you choose to send us, plus the technical data any website receives.

bullets.reviews: If you submit a review: your name, your email address, your country, a rating and your comment. The email address lets us contact you about the review if we need to — it is stored, and it is never published.
bullets.enquiries: If you send an enquiry: your name, email address, phone number if you give one, company if you give one, whether you are writing as a pilgrim or as an agency, and your message.
bullets.messages: If you message us on WhatsApp or by email, we keep what you send so we can answer it and refer back to it.
bullets.technical: Technical data: your request is handled by Cloudflare, which records standard server and security information. We store a one-way hash of your IP address alongside a review or enquiry to limit spam — not the address itself.

use.title: What we use it for
use.body: Four things, and nothing else. We do not use your information for advertising, and we do not build profiles.

bullets.reply: To answer you, and to arrange what you have asked about.
bullets.publish: To publish approved reviews. A published review shows the name and country you gave, your rating and your comment. Your email address is never shown, and is not present in the page or in any data behind it.
bullets.protect: To protect the site from spam and abuse — this is what the bot check and the IP hash are for.
bullets.records: To keep an ordinary business record of enquiries and bookings.

legalBasis.title: Why we hold it
legalBasis.body: You give it to us so that we can respond, and that is the basis for everything above. Publishing a review rests on the consent you give when you submit it, and you can withdraw that at any time.

sharing.title: Who else sees it
sharing.body: We do not sell information and we do not share it for advertising. A small number of providers process it on our behalf:

bullets.hosting: Cloudflare — hosting, content delivery, and the bot check on our forms.
bullets.email: Resend — delivering notification and confirmation emails.
bullets.never: Nobody else, except where passing a detail on is necessary to arrange something you have specifically asked us to arrange — a hotel booking in your name, for instance.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: This site sets no advertising or analytics cookies. Your language choice is carried in the address of the page rather than in a cookie. Cloudflare's security and bot-check services may set strictly necessary cookies; those exist to keep the site available, not to follow you around other sites.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body: Enquiries and messages are kept while they remain useful to running the business — an old enquiry is often the context for a later booking. Published reviews stay until you or we remove them. If you would like something deleted, ask, and we will delete it unless we are required to keep it.

rights.title: What you can ask for
rights.body: Write to us at the address at the end of this page and we will act on any of the following.

bullets.access: A copy of what we hold about you.
bullets.correct: A correction to anything that is wrong.
bullets.remove: Deletion of your enquiry, your message or your published review.
bullets.withdraw: Withdrawal of consent to publish a review, which takes it off the site.

security.title: How it is kept
security.body: The site is served over HTTPS, so what you send is encrypted in transit. Stored information sits in our database on Cloudflare's infrastructure and is reachable only through the private admin system, which is invitation-only and has no public sign-up.

children.title: Children
children.body: This website is intended for adults arranging travel. We do not knowingly collect information from children. If a child has sent us something, tell us and we will remove it.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: We will update this page when what we do changes, and the date at the top will change with it. This is an early version and will be revised.

contactUs.title: Contact
contactUs.body: Questions about this policy, or a request about your own information: write to {email} or call {phone}.

meta.title: Terms & conditions
meta.description: The terms that apply to using the Nusuk Help website, and how they relate to the booking terms issued with a confirmed reservation.

terms.title: Terms & conditions
terms.lead: These terms cover the use of this website. The terms that govern an actual booking are issued with your confirmation and printed on your invoice, and those are the ones that apply to the reservation itself.

who.title: Who these terms are from
who.body: This website is operated by Nusuk Help, a travel services company based in Madinah Al Munawarah, Saudi Arabia. Al Haramain Reservation is its B2B division. Using the site means accepting the terms on this page.

services.title: What we do
services.body: We arrange hotels, transport, Haramain rail seats, ziyarat and ground handling with hotels and suppliers, and we assist with the official permit process. We are not a hotel, a carrier, a rail operator or a government body, and this site is not a booking engine — nothing on it books anything. A reservation exists only once we have confirmed it to you in writing.

permits.title: Permit assistance
permits.body: Permits are issued by the Saudi authorities through their own official channels, and the decision is always theirs. Our role is assistance, guidance and coordination with that process: explaining what is required, helping prepare an application, and supporting you through it. We cannot obtain a permit on your behalf, we have no access to any official system that is not open to every applicant, and no application's approval can be promised.

independence.title: Independence
independence.body: We are an independent company. Nothing on this site should be read as a claim to act for, or with the authority of, any official body.

information.title: Information on this site
information.body: Descriptions, service lists and any prices shown here are for information. They are not an offer, and they are subject to availability. Rates, rooms, seats and timings are confirmed for your dates at the time of booking, and can change until they are confirmed.

bookingTerms.title: The terms that govern a booking
bookingTerms.body: These website terms are not the booking terms. When a reservation is confirmed, the booking terms in force at that moment are issued with the confirmation and printed in full on the invoice, and those are the ones that apply to the reservation. Ask us for the current version at any time. They cover, among other things:

bullets.payment: Payment and confirmation, including what must be paid before a booking is finally confirmed.
bullets.cancellation: Cancellation, amendment and refund, which follow the relevant hotel or supplier policy.
bullets.hotel: Hotel policies — check-in and check-out times, occupancy, meals, deposits and extras.
bullets.liability: What happens when a hotel, supplier, authority or transport operator causes a change outside our control.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.body: Reviews are checked before they appear, and we may decline or remove one. Submit only your own honest experience, and nothing unlawful, abusive, or identifying of another person. By submitting a review you allow us to publish your name, country, rating and comment on this site; your email address is never published. Ask us and we will remove your review.

content.title: Content and marks
content.body: The text, images, layout and marks on this site — including the Nusuk Help and Al Haramain Reservation names and logos — belong to us or are used with permission. Please do not reproduce them without asking. Any third-party names mentioned belong to their respective owners.

liability.title: Liability
liability.body: We take care over what is published here, but we do not warrant that it is complete or current, and the site is provided as it is. To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for loss arising from use of this website. Nothing here limits any liability that cannot lawfully be limited, and nothing here affects the terms that govern a confirmed booking.

law.title: Governing law
law.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: We may update these terms, and the date at the top will change when we do. This is an early version and will be revised.
